description: Nightly build of q2, the Rust implementation of the next version of Quarto.
notes: q2 is experimental software, not yet ready for production use.
Nightly builds replace the previous one on GitHub: only the latest nightly is installable.
This package and 'q2' both provide q2.exe. Use 'scoop reset q2' or 'scoop reset q2-nightly' to switch.
